description: This file contains test cases for the 'data product publishing API' within the backend API of the Data Insights Dashboard project. It uses pytest and asyncio for concurrency, and tests various API endpoints including submission creation, quality gates, approval workflows, security/authentication/authorization scenarios, electronic signature validation, and integrity checks. The tests include positive scenarios, negative cases, expected failures, and placeholders for features not yet implemented.
